rulings_in_order: - Ruling: Admission health excludes assigned infrastructure, timeout and context-overflow failures, but retains parser/citation/abstention/output-cap failures as measured semantics. All sessions must be exact and quiescent. If wrong, this gate may reject a useful prompt because of operational faults rather than efficacy.

- Ruling: An assigned infrastructure failure permanently ends this candidate stage; clean boundary pauses and startup failures before any assigned observation may resume untouched jobs only after quiescence. If wrong, a recoverable failure may waste a study reservation and leave an inconclusive result.
